entities.summary: Rafael Montero is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher in the New York Yankees organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Texas Rangers, Seattle Mariners, Houston Astros, Atlanta Braves and Detroit Tigers. Montero signed with the Mets as an international free agent in 2011, and made his MLB debut with them in 2014.
